discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 0d6a368e. The cache now uses the numeric timeout for both its in-flight key and its transport. In a loopback test, simultaneous callers using 1000 and "1e3" received the same response from one wire request, and a subsequent call read the cached result.
Fixed in 8432c47: enableTrace bypasses cache reads and writes. The cache-enabled actual SDK fixture verifies two requests return fresh, distinct trace session IDs.

Confirmed that Retrieve dispatches each request even when caching is enabled. This is an optional optimization rather than an incorrect result: retrieval, pagination, guardrail outcomes, and request accounting are preserved, and existing RetrieveAndGenerate caching is unchanged. Keeping fresh retrieval in this change avoids introducing a new cache with incomplete authorization and pagination isolation. A future cache implementation should explicitly define those boundaries and replay provenance.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Confirmed by pinned main/original-PR/current-head controls: Agent cache separation for explicit/default credentials and profiles was already absent before this change. This is an inherited limitation that remains documented for separate hardening. The suggested helper fingerprints configured credentials but does not identify changes in the default credential chain, so copying it would not fully address the report. No new credential hashing or account-lookup architecture was added here. Mixed-credential evaluations should use `--no-cache` until that broader cache-identity contract is addressed.

The representation is not as compact as base64, but the measured regression claim does not hold. A bounded 131,072-byte provider-cache comparison shows Buffer serialization unchanged at 262,564 bytes on base and head; Uint8Array serialization improves from 1,288,870 bytes (numeric-key JSON) to 262,564 bytes (arrays). Both encodings replay through the current provider with exact image/reasoning bytes, identical canonical media/native metadata, and unchanged tool JSON. There is no reproduced truncation or replay defect. Treating a different cache codec as an optional optimization and keeping this fix scoped.
Fixed in 2cdfdeccf. Identical moderation calls sharing the same AbortSignal now coalesce in a signal-keyed WeakMap. Different signals retain isolated requests. Both cases are tested.

Confirmed and fixed in fdaf6e513. The cache await now checks an already-aborted signal before registering a listener and detaches the listener immediately on cancellation; the underlying promise remains observed for later rejection. A focused regression checks no listener is added when the cache read cancels synchronously. Full backend: 24,180 passed.
